draft_notes.author: host parallel CLI execution worker
draft_notes.explanation: Native mechanism: template T (hollow box, or 4-connected creature grown from (0,0) and touching column w-1) is drawn twice, and T with one column deleted is drawn once. The placements are separated by >=1 cell. The T copies become palette[1]; all derived material becomes palette[2], even when the deletion splits it into several 8-components. The program works in visible coordinates: it finds 8-components of non-BG cells and keys them by cropped mask. It enumerates three readings: pair_template (the constructor parse: the unique largest repeated mask occurs exactly twice, and the union of all other material equals that mask minus one line along DEL_AXIS), all_repeated (the archived rule) and exactly_twice. It keeps only readings that reproduce every demo exactly, then requires every survivor to be defined on the query and to agree on the full query output. Otherwise it raises. BG/ONE/TWO come from palette[0,1,2]. DEL_AXIS is the visible axis of the native column, explicitly specialised from d4: an odd number of rotations swaps the axes, and the row reversal does not.

ambiguity_analysis.intrinsic: None. The exhaustive enumeration (evidence_exhaustive_b230c067.py, 21861 reachable template x badcol cases) shows that every fragment is strictly smaller than T and that T occurs exactly twice. The independent all-pairs constructor-parse enumeration is unique in every case. A cell-count argument covers any placement: a pair of fragments would leave >=2|T| cells for a remainder that must have <|F| cells.
ambiguity_analysis.context_shortfall: In 39 of 21861 template cases (about 0.034% of native pairs, measured as 68/200000), the deletion splits the derived sprite into 2 identical fragments. On such a query, all_repeated and exactly_twice disagree with the constructor. They are refuted only by a demo that also has repeated fragments. Concrete counterexample: context-shortfall-counterexample-b230c067.json (canonical demos plus a native-generated hard query). Both readings reproduce every demo, the outputs differ at 2 cells, and the program raises on all 16 variants. Max identical fragments is 2, so all_repeated == exactly_twice on the whole domain.
ambiguity_analysis.resolution: Keep the query and resample demos from the native generator until the independent gate reports 'determined'. The generator is not narrowed and hard queries are kept.
